date_scope_check.qualification_retained:
ME032-D1: Reuters quotes a border official dating closure to late July 1; the July 2 crossing-administration announcement reported by Enab Baladi dates its suspension announcement to July 2. These may describe the Turkish closure and the subsequent Syrian-side notice, so July 1 is retained as the attributed onset, not an independently timed first barrier. The July 3 passenger and lorry restoration is administration-reported. The two-day calendar difference is not measured 48 hours.

Other gates: A July 8 report quotes or summarizes gate administrations announcing restored commercial-truck movement at Bab al Salam and al Rai. SOHR still reported both closed on July 7. Bab al Salam passenger permits were not included in that restoration. No general passenger endpoint or continuous numeric duration is inferred for these gates.
date_scope_check.review_limit: No dates, unknown reopenings, duration classifications or continuity assumptions changed by this geographic review.
